subject: Scheduling: 90-min Latency Benchmark Readout with FinCo

Subject: Re: Benchmark readout — initial request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the pilot run last week — team was impressed with throughput. We'd like a formal readout of the latency/99th-percentile results and to review routing/fallback behavior with our DevSecOps and procurement folks. High-level ask: 60–90 minutes to go over results, ops implications, and procurement next steps.

Attendees on our side: Alan Choe (Eng lead), Priya Singh (Procurement), Anil Desai (DevOps), security team (cc'd secops@finco.com).

Our preferred windows (PST):
- Wed Jul 11: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu Jul 12: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00

Can you propose a 60–90 minute slot and confirm who from Redwood will present? Also, procurement will need a SOC2 snapshot and a short note on data retention to move a PO forward.

Thanks,
Alan

Then a 60-minute readout covering: 1) results summary, 2) routing/fallback demo, 3) cost/perf tradeoffs and recommended configs, 4) Q&A.

I also attached a SOC2 snapshot per Priya's request (redacted for policy).
